This is the lowest-complexity current route to proving an actual customerless payout.

Choose the Gridcoin plus Curecoin double-reward Folding path; this requires additional wallet/registration setup before the same kind of benchmark.
Decline all hardware revenue experiments and leave Yield Harvester in read-only mode.

No continuous operation will be authorized by the benchmark approval; the system stops and evaluates measured economics first.
